title: Understanding Roles and Entities: Datasets and Models for Natural Language Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Natural Language Inference (NLI) models on NER-CHANGED and ROLE-SWAPPED premise-hypothesis datasets to measure their over-reliance on word embedding similarity (e.g., predicting 'entailment' just because the substituted names have similar vector representations) rather than true semantic understanding of entities and roles.
